newsitem.title: USA: AEP 1,090 MW Cook 2 nuke seen on line Tues.
newsitem.headline: AEP 1,090 MW Cook 2 nuke seen on line Tues.

text.p: American Electric Power Co Inc's 1,090 megawatt (MW) Cook nuclear power unit 2 was expected to resume electricity production Tuesday following an unexpected repair outage, a company spokesman said Monday.
The unit was in a start-up mode as of Monday morning and was expected to synchronize to the electricity grid on Tuesday, the spokesman said.
The unit tripped off line March 14 after a feed regulator valve controller failed.
The adjoining 1,020 MW Cook nuclear unit 1 has been shut since Feb 28 for scheduled refueling and maintenance, and was expected to return to service in mid-April.
The Cook units are located in Bridgman, Mich.
